description:
Our group at Cambridge works on Earth Observation foundation models (Tessera: v1 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20380, v2 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03949, https://geotessera.org/) and we've started a collaboration with Manchester to understand how they can be used to improve pollution models and then environmental decision making in general. This involves training new models and doing high-resolution inference across national or even global scales, as well as figuring out how to use that data to help policymakers make better decisions.
As part of this work we have a PhD studentship through the joint Manchester-Cambridge Centre for Doctoral Training for AI in Decision Making for Complex Systems. This involves one year at Manchester doing taught postgraduate study and then three years at Cambridge for the PhD.
Our work is all open source and involves solving significant compute and data challenges. Training our current-generation model takes ~250k GPU hours and a single year of global inference needs to move over 5.5 petabytes of data through the inference pipeline. This project would suit someone with strong machine learning and software engineering experience. We can help you build the atmospheric science and Earth Observation skills.
We are a highly collaborative group who spend our time not only on foundational research but also on developing applications with practitioners and decision makers. Our work sees use in many industrial, academic and government environments for problems like crop classification, tree species mapping and change detection.

description:

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b

Position: Technical Support Engineer

Salary: 25,000 ZAR to 32,000 ZAR 

Working Hours: Aligned with UK Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Our company isn't just scaling; we're redefining human risk and secure behaviour management in cybersecurity. Trusted by leading global enterprises including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva, and Hershey, we reduce human cyber risk through AI-driven automation, with Agentic AI expanding our capabilities even further.

In this company, support is where the product meets reality. Every ticket represents a customer telling us something true about the platform—and every issue is either something we repeatedly answer, or a problem we solve once and eliminate at the source. We view support as an integral extension of product engineering, not a downstream cost centre.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a high-calibre Technical Support Engineer to take full ownership of our tier-2/tier-3 technical customer support function. This is a technical, investigative engagement—not a script-reading helpdesk.

Operating as an independent contractor based in South Africa, you will manage customer issues end to end: diagnosing logs and error records, reproducing complex platform issues in dedicated test tenants, handing fully documented, reproduction-ready defect packages to the Product Lead, and actively closing the loop by removing recurring root causes from our product, documentation, or onboarding flows.

You will inherit a high-discipline, high-efficiency operational setup powered by modern observability, AI acceleration, and proactive tenant-level monitoring.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
End-to-End Case Resolution

- Manage the inbound queue via Intercom, triaging by severity and business impact, meeting strict SLAs, and proactively setting clear expectations for next updates.

- Conduct deep diagnostic investigations before reaching out to customers: analyze error/event records, audit logs, browser console outputs, network traces, API request/response payloads, mail flow, and multi-tenant configurations.

- Reproduce issues in staging/test tenants. If an issue is elusive, correlate system data across tenant IDs, timestamps, and user telemetry to isolate the failure state.

- Package and escalate verified defects directly to the Product Lead. Every escalation must contain reproduction steps, tenant/user IDs, UTC timestamps, relevant log excerpts, and ruled-out variables to allow immediate engineering action without rework.

- Maintain complete ownership of the customer communication loop during escalation cycles, verifying hotfixes against your original reproduction steps prior to closing cases.

- Monitor proactive health alerts across tenant accounts (e.g., in Sentry), identifying failures before customers do and initiating contact with pre-empted fixes.

- Track bi-weekly release cycles: review release notes on deployment day, validate altered functionality in sandbox environments, and resolve pending customer cases impacted by updates.

Root-Cause Elimination & Product Evolution

- Classify every resolved ticket by verified root cause: product defect, documentation gap, UX friction, environmental configuration, feature limitation, or edge-case anomaly.

- Conduct root-cause analysis on repeating issue categories to identify architectural, operational, or instructional fixes.

- Directly author and maintain Help Centre articles, implementation guides, and troubleshooting documentation to drive customer self-service.

- Surface UX friction points to the Product Lead backed by empirical evidence (user journeys, reproduction paths, screenshots, and aggregate impact metrics).

- Report on support metrics using empirical data: ticket volumes categorized by cause, trend trajectories, and high-impact preventative targets.

- Leverage approved AI acceleration tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) responsibly to speed up technical research, verifying all outputs against source data prior to customer transmission.

- 3+ years of technical support, application support, product support, or customer-facing engineering experience dedicated to a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform.

- Proven track record supporting technical B2B enterprise buyers, such as CISOs, IT Directors, SOC teams, security engineers, or system administrators.

- Demonstrated competency diagnosing multi-tenant architectures, recognizing tenant-specific misconfigurations versus global system incidents.

- Strong working knowledge of web technologies: browser developer tools, HTTP status codes, REST APIs, JSON payloads, and log analysis.

- Demonstrated history of systemic root-cause resolution (e.g., authored documentation that deflected ticket volume, initiated a UX change, or caught critical bugs).

- Hands-on experience with modern support and service platforms (Intercom preferred; or Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot Service Hub, Front).

- Flawless written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to convey technical diagnostics plainly and confidently under pressure.

- Proven self-directed problem-solving ability, with an aptitude for learning complex platform capabilities directly from architecture docs.

- Fully equipped home office environment in South Africa, including high-speed fibre internet, dedicated backup power (UPS/inverter) for load-shedding resilience, and quality AV peripherals.

PREFERRED:

- Domain exposure to cybersecurity, secure email gateways, or human risk management platforms (e.g., KnowBe4, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Hoxhunt, Abnormal).

- Working familiarity with enterprise mail flow systems: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC record handling.

- Familiarity with identity architecture and directory integrations: SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, Active Directory, or Entra ID (Azure AD).

- Practical ability to write and execute read-only SQL queries.

- Exposure to modern web/cloud stacks (e.g., Cloudflare, Nuxt, Vue, PostgreSQL, Sentry).

- Working knowledge of enterprise compliance standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, UK GDPR) in a data-handling capacity.

- Active Intercom certification (or commitment to achieve certification within 90 days of engagement).

What You’ll Bring:

- Investigation-First Mindset: A refusal to guess or relay unverified theories. You look at logs, inspect configurations, reproduce the scenario, and present verified data.

- Customer Empathy Without the Runaround: You never send the customer a boilerplate troubleshooting checklist for information you could pull from internal logs yourself.

- Accountability & Integrity: You set expectations accurately (e.g., "I am investigating this log sequence and will update you by 14:00"), communicate transparently, and follow through predictably.

- Calm, Consultative Demeanor: Composure and clarity when de-escalating frustrated enterprise customers.

- Product-Minded Curiosity: An instinct to treat every resolved ticket as product feedback, asking why the problem existed and advocating for fixes that eliminate the issue permanently.

We're looking for an SEO Content Specialist to help execute our content and AI-first search strategy. Your work will be measured by its impact on traffic, AI visibility and sign-ups, not by how much you publish.

Responsibilities

title: مستشار توجيه (Guidance Consultant)
description:

About ComPsych

تُعد شركة ComPsych® Corporation أكبر مزود عالمي لخدمات الصحة النفسية وبرامج GuidanceResources® للحياة. وانطلاقاً من التزامها الراسخ بالابتكار المتواصل وتبنيها لنهج شامل في تقديم الرعاية، توفر ComPsych خدماتها لأكثر من 163 مليون فرد موزعين على 200 دولة. وتحت مظلة علامتنا التجارية GuidanceResources®، نقدم برامج مخصصة ومتكاملة تماماً تشمل مجالات الصحة السلوكية، وإدارة حالات الغياب، ومسارات العافية؛ وهي برامج تهدف إلى تمكين الموظفين من عيش حياة أكثر صحة وإنتاجية، فضلاً عن تعزيز التميز المؤسسي. تفضل بزيارة موقع compsych.com لتكتشف الأسباب التي دفعت 40% من الشركات المدرجة ضمن قائمة "Fortune 500" لاختيار ComPsych لتلبية احتياجاتها المتعلقة بالصحة النفسية.

 

 

ComPsych® Corporation is the world’s largest provider of mental health services and GuidanceResources® for life. Fueled by a commitment to relentless innovation and a comprehensive approach to care, ComPsych provides services to more than 163 million individuals across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our personalized and fully integrated programs include behavioral health, absence, and wellness journeys, which empower employees to lead healthier and more productive lives, while driving organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health needs.

About the Role

 

المسمى الوظيفي هو "استشاري توجيه" (Guidance Consultant)، وهي وظيفة تعتمد نظام العمل عن بُعد ومقرها دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة. تُعد هذه الوظيفة عقداً محدد المدة وبدوام كامل، وهي مثالية للمتخصصين في مجال الصحة النفسية ممن يقدّرون التميز السريري ويتحلون بالتعاطف في نهجهم المهني، فضلاً عن قدرتهم على النجاح والتميز في بيئة عمل سريعة الإيقاع تضع سهولة الوصول وسرعة الاستجابة والرعاية المتمحورة حول العميل في

 

يقوم مستشارو التوجيه بتقديم دعم مباشر للعملاء عبر الهاتف والمحادثات النصية، حيث يتناولون القضايا المتعلقة بالصحة السلوكية، والرفاه العاطفي، والشؤون الأسرية، ومسائل العافية الشاملة؛ وذلك بمنتهى الاحترافية والتعاطف، وبالاستناد إلى حكم سريري سديد.

 

وبصفتها جزءاً من أكبر جهة مزودة في العالم لـ "برامج مساعدة الموظفين" (EAP) وخدمات الرعاية المُدارة للصحة السلوكية، فإن هذه الوظيفة تتيح فرصة استثنائية للنمو المهني. إذ يوظف المستشارون خبراتهم السريرية لتقديم الدعم الفوري في لحظة الحاجة، وتوجيه العملاء نحو الموارد المتاحة، وتسهيل إجراء الإحالات المناسبة وفي الوقت المناسب، لضمان استمرارية الرعاية وتحقيق نتائج إيجابية.

 

 

 

The job title is Guidance Consultant and is a remote working role residing in the country of United Arab Emirates. This is a Fixed-Term, Full-Time position and is ideal for mental health professionals who value clinical excellence and lead with empathy, and who thrive in a fast-paced environment where access, responsiveness, and client-centered care are essential.

 

Guidance Consultants provide direct client support via telephone and chat, addressing behavioral health, emotional well-being, family concerns, and overall wellness-related issues with professionalism, compassion, and sound clinical judgment.

 

As part of the world’s largest provider of Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and managed behavioral health care services, this role offers an exceptional opportunity for professional growth. Consultants leverage their clinical expertise to deliver in-the-moment support, guide clients through available resources, and facilitate timely, appropriate referrals to ensure continuity of care and positive outcomes.

 

What You'll Do

تقديم الدعم عبر الهاتف والمحادثة النصية من خلال إجراء تقييمات سريرية أولية شاملة، وإحالة العملاء إلى الموارد المناسبة، بما في ذلك المعالجون النفسيون، والمرشدون، وموارد العافية ذات الصلة.

 إجراء تقييمات للعملاء وتطبيق منهجيات التدريب (Coaching) لتطوير استراتيجيات مخصصة للصحة والعافية تدعم إحداث تغيير إيجابي في السلوك.

 ضمان الالتزام ببروتوكولات القسم، وأفضل الممارسات المتبعة في القطاع، والمتطلبات الخاصة بالعملاء؛ وذلك للحفاظ على الامتثال التنظيمي وضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة.

 تقديم الخدمات بأسلوب يتسم بالكفاءة الثقافية، والشمولية، والاحترام للأفراد من خلفيات متنوعة وذوي احتياجات متباينة.

 توظيف التقدير السليم للمواقف، والتفكير النقدي، ومهارات حل المشكلات لتقييم الحالات، ومعالجة الشواغل بسرعة، وتسهيل تقديم الدعم المناسب لتعزيز تجربة العميل الشاملة.

 توعية العملاء بالموارد المتاحة، ومعايير الأهلية، والخدمات التي يقدمها البرنامج بأسلوب مهني ومتعاطف.

 الحفاظ على توثيق دقيق وشامل وفي الوقت المناسب لجميع التفاعلات مع العملاء ضمن نظام قاعدة البيانات الخاص بالمؤسسة.

 البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث الاتجاهات والموارد وأفضل الممارسات الناشئة في مجال الصحة السلوكية، وذلك لتعزيز جودة تقديم الخدمات بشكل مستمر.

 التعاون مع الأطراف المعنية (أصحاب المصلحة) داخل المؤسسة وخارجها لضمان استمرارية الرعاية ومواءمة الخدمات مع التوقعات المحددة لكل عميل.

الالتزام الصارم بالسرية الطبية ولوائح حماية البيانات المعمول بها (مثل: GDPR في أوروبا، وPDPA في سنغافورة، وPIPEDA في كندا، وPDPL في الإمارات العربية المتحدة).

 أداء أي مهام إضافية أخرى تُسند إليه.

 

 

- Provide telephonic and chat support by conducting comprehensive clinical intakes and referring clients to appropriate resources, including therapists, counselors and relevant wellness resources.

- Conduct client assessments and apply coaching methodologies to develop tailored health and well-being strategies that support positive behavior change

- Ensure adherence to departmental protocols, industry best practices, and customer-specific requirements to maintain compliance and high-quality service delivery.

- Deliver services in a culturally competent, inclusive, and respectful manner to individuals from diverse backgrounds with varying needs.

- Apply sound judgment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to assess situations, resolve concerns promptly, and facilitate appropriate support to enhance the overall client experience.

- Educate clients regarding available resources, eligibility criteria, and program services in a professional and empathetic manner.

- Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely documentation of all client interactions within the organization’s proprietary database system.

- Stay informed on emerging behavioral health trends, resources, and best practices to continuously enhance service delivery.

- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure continuity of care and alignment with client-specific service expectations.

- Maintain strict adherence to medical confidentiality and applicable data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR in Europe, PDPA in Singapore, PIPEDA in Canada, PDPL in UAE)

- Perform additional duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

 يُشترط الحصول على درجة الماجستير أو ما يعادلها من مؤهلات الدراسات العليا في علم النفس، أو الخدمة الاجتماعية، أو الصحة السلوكية، أو أي مجال ذي صلة بالصحة السلوكية من مؤسسة معترف بها.

 في حال كان الإطار التنظيمي المهني المعمول به في بلد أو ولاية العمل يعترف بشهادة البكالوريوس كمعيار أساسي للالتحاق بالتخصص ذي الصلة، يُمكن اعتبار هذه الشهادة من مؤسسة معترف بها، بالإضافة إلى الخبرة العملية ذات الصلة بعد الحصول عليها، معادلةً لها.

 يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة لممارسة المهنة و/أو الحصول على الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثما يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة للتأهل للممارسة المهنية و/أو الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثم

  يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

 الأهلية لممارسة المهنة و/أو التسجيل في بلد الإقامة وفقًا للوائح الوطنية

 إجادة استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس وأنظمة معلومات العملاء

 إجادة اللغتين الإنجليزية والعربية (لغة الإمارات العربية المتحدة)

 يُفضل الحصول على شهادات معترف بها في مجال التدريب الصحي أو العافية

 يُفضل الخبرة في العمل ضمن بيئات متعددة الثقافات أو دولية

 القدرة على تقديم دعم يركز على العميل مع تعاطف قوي، ومهارات استماع فعّالة، ومهارات تدريبية

 مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع توجه قوي نحو خدمة العملاء

 القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة بسرية تامة والحفاظ على خصوصيتها

 سرعة البديهة، والنشاط، والإيجابية، والاحترافية، مع مهارات مثبتة في إدارة المهام المتعددة والتفكير النقدي وإدارة الأزمات أو المواقف عالية الخطورة

 

متطلبات أخرى

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

- Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.

- Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.

- Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

- Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.

- Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.

- Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

- Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.

- Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.

- Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

- Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.

- Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.

- Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

- Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.

- Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

-

Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

- Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.

- Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

- Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.

- Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

-

Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

- 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.

- Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

- A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

- Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.

- Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.

- Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.

- Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.

- Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.

- Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.

- Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

-

Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.

- Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.

- A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.

- Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.

- Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.

- Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.

- Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).

- Kubernetes/EKS experience.

- Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

title: Autonomous Systems Security Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly (Travel Required) | San Francisco, CA

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited.

You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

-

Autonomous security and inspection systems: own the drones, ground robots and other autonomous platforms for perimeter patrol, incident response and infrastructure inspection: platform selection, operating model, operator qualification, maintenance, and the data path from machine to analyst

-

Tools, automation and AI agents: build the integrations that carry detections, tracks, telemetry and fleet health into the team's security monitoring platform, and the tools and agents that triage detections, check fleet health and assemble evidence. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

-

Detection of uncrewed systems: engineer the sensing that tells us what is flying over or operating near a site, what it is and who needs to know: sensor selection and evaluation against live targets, per-site coverage, classification and false-alarm handling, and the playbook from first detection to handoff, with evidence retained

-

Security of site automation: engineer the controls on automated vehicles, robots and similar machines that move hardware or work inside secure areas: identity and access, network isolation, what they may record and where it goes, fail-secure behavior, their place in chain of custody, and acceptance before they enter a site

-

Regulatory and site constraints: establish what we may sense, fly, drive, record and retain at each site, partner-operated sites included, under the aviation, spectrum, privacy and safety rules that apply there, with the waivers and approvals that extend it and coordination with local authorities set up before it is needed

-

Health monitoring: define and test heartbeats, loss-of-coverage and lost-link alarms and fail-secure behavior, so a silent sensor or machine shows as a fault, not a quiet day

-

Vendor requirements and acceptance: write the requirements, evaluate against live flights and runs, and hold vendors to what they ship

Minimum qualifications

-

Have engineered autonomous or sensing systems in the field (drones, ground robots, automated vehicles, or RF, radar or optical detection sensors): selected, integrated or secured them for an operation other people relied on, and verified what they actually do against real targets or runs rather than a datasheet

-

Have integrated systems you did not build (vendor APIs, SDKs, appliances, machine and sensor telemetry) into a platform that outlives any one of them

-

Read and review code, design the data systems behind security tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

-

Have done this work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

-

Have designed inside a regulatory or safety constraint (aviation, spectrum, privacy, machine safety or similar) and can show the decision it drove

-

Own a domain end to end: set the approach, carry it through with vendors, site operators, partners and authorities, and run it as something people depend on every day

Preferred qualifications

-

Remote pilot certification (for example FAA Part 107) and experience flying beyond visual line of sight under a waiver or exemption

-

Experience with counter-drone (counter-UAS) detection, airspace surveillance or air traffic data systems

-

Experience running a robot, drone or automated-vehicle fleet in an industrial, logistics or data center setting: fleet management, mission planning, safety cases

-

Experience securing embedded, operational technology or robotic systems: device identity, network segmentation, update control, logging

-

Experience with physical security operations at large sites, with law enforcement or aviation authorities, or at sites you did not fully control: cloud, colocation or GPU cloud operators

-

Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
